name: claude-quickstarts
description: A collection of projects designed to help developers quickly get started with building deployable applications using the Claude API
one_liner: A grab-bag of ready-made example apps (support bots, a financial analyst chatbot, a browsing agent) that show developers exactly how to build something useful on top of Claude.
buyer: A freelance developer or small dev shop that wants to pitch and build Claude-powered apps for clients fast, without starting from a blank page.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer forks the customer-support-agent quickstart to build and sell a branded support bot to a small e-commerce client in days instead of weeks.
An agency uses the financial-data-analyst quickstart as the base for a paid 'chat with your spreadsheets' tool for bookkeeping clients.
A trainer runs a hands-on 'build your first AI agent' workshop using these quickstarts as the exercises.

money_ideas.idea: Rapid client-build service: a working Claude app in a week, scaffolded from these quickstarts
Paid cohort-based workshop teaching non-developers to launch one of these quickstarts

steal_this: Take the customer-support-agent quickstart, swap in a real client's FAQ knowledge base, and have a working demo ready to sell by Monday.
